conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Priya calling from Amazon Seller Central Support. Am I speaking with the owner of BlueSky Home Goods?
Yes, this is Michelle. How can I help you?

Hi Michelle, thank you for taking my call. We are conducting a security audit on Amazon seller accounts, and we noticed some irregular activity on your seller portal. I want to reassure you that this is a routine check, and we're here to help keep your account safe.
Irregular activity? That sounds worrying. What did you see?

Our system flagged multiple login attempts from an unrecognized location. To protect you from potential unauthorized access, we need to verify your account details and guide you through a quick security process. Do you have access to your computer at this time?
Yes, I'm at my laptop now.
Excellent. First, for your security, can you please confirm the phone number and email address associated with your Amazon seller account?
Sure, it's 555-290-8190 and michelle@blueskyhomegoods.com.
Thank you, Michelle. Now, in order to prevent any unauthorized changes or suspensions, I need you to log in to your Amazon Seller Central account. Please let me know once you're logged in.
Alright, I'm logged in.
Perfect. Now, you should have just received a pop-up notification about a 'restricted payout'. Did you see anything like that on your dashboard?
No, I don't see a pop-up. Is there something wrong with my payments?

No worries if it's not visible yet. Sometimes these alerts are delayed. To make sure we're proactive, I'm going to send you a secure verification link from Amazon's partner platform. This will allow us to confirm your account status. May I have your permission to send you this link to your email?
Yes, that's fine.
Thank you, Michelle. I have just sent an email with the subject line 'Amazon Account Verification'. Kindly open that email and click the blue 'Verify Now' button so we can move forward.
I see the email. Clicking the button now.

Great. A new window should open asking you to confirm your seller account details. Please fill in your full legal name, store name, and the last four digits of your bank account, just for verification.
Alright, I've entered Michelle Evans, BlueSky Home Goods, and 4129 for my bank.

Thank you. You're doing great, and this will help keep your account protected. Now, the system is showing an alert that your payout for the last sales cycle is temporarily on hold due to a system error. As part of the resolution, Amazon requires a small refundable transaction to verify the rightful account owner.
A transaction? Do I have to pay something? I thought this was just a check.

I understand your concern, Michelle. This is not a fee, it's a temporary authorization of $898 that will be fully refunded within 2-3 business days. This is Amazon policy to ensure funds aren't rerouted by unauthorized parties. You can choose your preferred method: Amazon gift card, Zelle, or direct wire.
I'd rather not do that, honestly. Is there any other way?

Unfortunately, this is the only way to release your pending payout and ensure your store stays active. Many sellers have completed this in the past without issue. Would you like me to guide you with the Zelle method? It's fast and secure.
If that's what I have to do, I guess Zelle is fine.
Thank you for your cooperation. Please open your banking app and go to the Zelle transfer section. Let me know when you're ready for the payment instructions.
Okay, I'm on the Zelle screen.
Please enter the recipient email as 'amazonsupport-refund@outlook.com', and enter $898 for the amount. In the memo, type your store name so our system can match your verification.
Alright, I entered all that. Should I send it now?
Yes, please go ahead and send the payment. Once it's processed, I will confirm the verification and your payout will be released.
Payment sent. How soon will I get the refund?

Thank you, Michelle. I see the payment was received. Generally, refunds are processed within two business days. I will email you a confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your Amazon store?
No, that's everything. I just want to make sure my account is safe.

Absolutely. Your cooperation has helped secure your account. If you notice any further alerts or issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to Amazon Seller Support directly. Have a wonderful day, Michelle.
